integrity.claim_scope: Over \(\mathbb Q\), the three-dimensional non-degenerate, non-perfect evolution algebra with \(v=e_1+e_2+e_3\), \(w=e_1\), \(e_1^2=v\), \(e_2^2=-v\), \(e_3^2=w\), and \(e_i e_j=0\) for \(i\ne j\) has trivial algebra automorphism group, yet has infinitely many natural bases modulo permutation and nonzero rescaling.

scientific_limitations: The construction is over Q and gives an existence example only.
It strengthens the finite-automorphism phenomenon to a trivial automorphism group in dimension \(3\) with \(\dim A^2=2\); it does not classify all such algebras.
Targeted literature/database retrieval is not a proof of global novelty.
title: A rigid evolution algebra with infinitely many natural bases
